name: Somerset
summary: NSL stop between Orchard and Dhoby Ghaut — theatre/mall adjacency, dense condo stock, and city-core hops with tourist spillover as the tax.
body: Somerset is the shortlist when North-South Line access and a position between Orchard retail and Dhoby Ghaut interchange matter. Housing is mostly condo and serviced-apartment edges; weekend tourist and mall spillover are real. Expats land here for car-light city-core living and shorter hops to CBD desks, not quiet estate texture. Compare with Orchard for deeper mall spine energy, Dhoby Ghaut for multi-line optionality, and River Valley when you want nightlife without the full tourist crush.
bestFor: car-light workers who want Orchard and CBD in short hops
renters comparing serviced vs proper TA
people who will use ActiveSG / community studios for classes
watchOuts: MCST parcel locker culture varies by tower
housingMix: Condo and serviced-apartment stock with limited quiet HDB texture.
commuteNotes: North-South Line at Somerset; test a Friday 18:30 station exit and a Sunday afternoon mall walk.
